scope: Class/function checked increment and complete constructor receivers; includes the preceding tuple-adapter arity guard
coveredBoundaries: All class fields must be definitely assigned at the use site
Aliases, publication, method/getter/setter/private method access and dynamic-receiver function fields
Lexical receiver retention across collection and async execution
Base/derived initialization, inherited-field redeclaration, generic specializations and abrupt completion after publication
Late generic descendants rejected before execution; pre-super/default/partial receivers and constructor returns remain refused
v37/v36/legacy module and diagnostic fingerprints unchanged
Dev execution and source-free Wasm, native companion and standalone artifacts
limitations: Local macOS arm64 only; no remote CI or cross-platform acceptance
The complete receiver rule requires no non-template descendants, even if a non-generic descendant is never constructed
Arbitrary partial-instance observation and assignments proven only through branches/callees remain outside this increment
Polymorphic/generic method identity, decorator semantics and property descriptors remain open
No new runtime readiness flag, layout, ABI, dependency or production-budget change
